loading-panel-dataset-picker.name: panel-session-dataset-picker
loading-panel-dataset-picker.describes: The Session panel showing the loaded Pancreatic endocrinogenesis dataset summary above the sample picker, with the pointer on the sample dropdown.

orientation-welcome-first-run.name: window-welcome-first-run
orientation-welcome-first-run.describes: The Cellucid welcome overlay as it appears on first load, over the sample dataset behind it.

orientation-window-overview.name: window-pancreas-overview
orientation-window-overview.describes: The Cellucid web app with the Pancreatic endocrinogenesis sample loaded in its 3D Orbit view, coloured by the clusters field, with the sidebar and legend visible.

coloring-panel-categorical-field.name: panel-coloring-categorical
coloring-panel-categorical-field.describes: The Coloring and Filtering panel with the clusters field selected as the categorical colouring source.

coloring-window-annotated-field-selector.name: window-annotated-color-by
coloring-window-annotated-field-selector.describes: The Cellucid web app with the categorical field selector ringed and the pointer pressing it, showing where the colouring field is chosen.

legend-region-categories.name: region-legend-categories
legend-region-categories.describes: The legend listing every category of the selected clusters field beside the reported visible-point count.

benchmark-panel-controls.name: benchmark-panel-controls
benchmark-panel-controls.describes: The Performance Benchmark panel before any run, showing the six point-count presets from 100K to 20M, the custom point count field, the data pattern dropdown, and the Load Synthetic Data, Copy Situation Report and Analyze Performance buttons.

filtering-panel-unfiltered.name: panel-clusters-unfiltered
filtering-panel-unfiltered.describes: The Coloring and Filtering panel with the clusters field selected: the three field selectors, the outlier slider at 100 percent, the eight-category legend, and the line Showing all 3,696 points above an empty filter list.

filtering-active-filters-three-rows.name: active-filters-three-rows
filtering-active-filters-three-rows.describes: The filter list holding three rows of different kinds at once: a clusters hiding row, an S_score numeric range row and a clusters outlier row, where only the first two carry a cell count.

filtering-window-outlier-95.name: window-outlier-95-applied
filtering-window-outlier-95.describes: The same window with the outlier slider at 95 percent: the scattered cells between the clusters are gone, the readout beside the slider says 95 percent, and a clusters outlier row has appeared in the filter list above a reduced count.

filtering-type-numeric-range.name: type-numeric-range
filtering-type-numeric-range.describes: The Filtering block of the continuous legend with Live filtering turned off: the helper line reads Drag sliders, then click Filter, and the FILTER button beside RESET is enabled with the pointer on it.

filtering-legend-category-unavailable.name: legend-category-unavailable
filtering-legend-category-unavailable.describes: The clusters legend under a narrow S_score range filter: most rows now print a visible-over-available count, and one row is greyed out with its checkbox and colour well disabled.

filtering-window-gene-range-active.name: window-gene-range-active
filtering-window-gene-range-active.describes: The whole window coloured by the gene Ins1 with the Min slider raised, so only expressing cells are drawn and an Ins1 range row is listed in the filter list.

filtering-window-zero-visible.name: window-zero-visible-cells
filtering-window-zero-visible.describes: The whole window with a completely empty canvas after pressing Hide All in the clusters legend, the sidebar reading Showing 0 of 3,696 points above one clusters hiding row.

annotation-lifecycle-01-disconnected.name: lifecycle-01-disconnected
annotation-lifecycle-01-disconnected.describes: The Community Annotation sidebar panel before any repository is connected, reading "No annotation repo connected." above a Connect repo button, with the pointer on that button.

annotation-lifecycle-02-signin.name: lifecycle-02-signin
annotation-lifecycle-02-signin.describes: Step 1 of 4 of the GitHub sync wizard, headed "Sign in with GitHub", with a Continue with GitHub button and a header showing the dataset plus GitHub and Repo both reading not connected.

annotation-lifecycle-03-install-app.name: lifecycle-03-install-app
annotation-lifecycle-03-install-app.describes: Step 2 of 4 of the wizard, headed "Install the GitHub App", listing repository cards marked Public or Private with Add repo and Reload buttons above and a pagination status line below.

annotation-lifecycle-05-sync.name: lifecycle-05-sync
annotation-lifecycle-05-sync.describes: Step 4 of 4 of the wizard, headed "Sync (pull / publish)", with Pull latest and Publish buttons, an Auto pull selector, and a status line reading "Pulled latest annotations."

annotation-lifecycle-06-connected-status.name: lifecycle-06-connected-status
annotation-lifecycle-06-connected-status.describes: The connected Community Annotation panel showing Dataset, Github and Repo rows, a GitHub sync button, a Profile block naming the signed-in user, and the Manage annotation, Derived consensus column and Consensus snapshot sections.

annotation-state-no-repository-matches-f.name: state-no-repository-matches-filter
annotation-state-no-repository-matches-f.describes: Step 3 of 4 of the wizard with a filter typed that matches no repository, showing "No repositories match this filter." above a status line reading "No repositories to display."

annotation-lifecycle-08-votable-badge.name: lifecycle-08-votable-badge
annotation-lifecycle-08-votable-badge.describes: The Coloring and Filtering categorical obs dropdown with the clusters entry prefixed by a ballot-box badge marking it open for voting.

annotation-lifecycle-07-manage-annotatio.name: lifecycle-07-manage-annotation
annotation-lifecycle-07-manage-annotatio.describes: The Manage annotation section expanded, showing the categorical obs picker with Add, Remove and Close buttons and the Annotatable consensus settings block with a Threshold slider and a Min annotators field.

filtering-active-filters-empty.name: active-filters-empty
filtering-active-filters-empty.describes: The block labelled Active filters (selected view only), reading Showing all 3,696 points above the words No filters active.

filtering-scope-tooltip.name: active-filters-scope-tooltip
filtering-scope-tooltip.describes: The information dialog beside the Active filters label, open and reading that filters stay with the selected panel when its coloring changes while other panels remain unchanged, with the pointer on the small i button that opened it.

filtering-window-all-visible.name: window-clusters-all-visible
filtering-window-all-visible.describes: The whole application window with the Pancreas embedding coloured by clusters, every legend row checked, and the sidebar reporting Showing all 3,696 points.

filtering-window-categories-hidden.name: window-clusters-three-hidden
filtering-window-categories-hidden.describes: The same window after unchecking Ductal, Ngn3 low EP and Ngn3 high EP: those points are absent from the canvas, their legend rows are unchecked with grey swatches, and the sidebar reports a reduced count above one filter row.

filtering-active-filters-one-row.name: active-filters-one-row
filtering-active-filters-one-row.describes: The filter list holding one row that names the clusters field and the three categories it hides, followed by a visible-over-available cell count, with a checkbox at its left edge and a remove cross at its right.

filtering-type-category-visibility.name: type-category-visibility
filtering-type-category-visibility.describes: The categorical legend for clusters: a Show All and a Hide All button above eight rows, three of them unchecked with grey swatches, each row carrying a colour swatch, a label and a cell count.

filtering-button-disabled-live-on.name: filter-button-disabled-live-on
filtering-button-disabled-live-on.describes: The same Filtering block with Live filtering on: the helper line reads Changes apply as you drag and the FILTER button is greyed out under the pointer.

filtering-window-continuous-range.name: window-continuous-range-applied
filtering-window-continuous-range.describes: The whole window coloured by S_score with the Min slider raised: only the higher-scoring cells are drawn, and the sidebar reports a reduced count above one S_score range row.

filtering-outlier-slider-95.name: outlier-slider-95
filtering-outlier-slider-95.describes: The control labelled Outlier filter (latent space) inside Display options, its slider moved left of the end stop and its readout showing 95 percent, with the pointer on the slider.

filtering-window-outlier-100.name: window-outlier-100-off
filtering-window-outlier-100.describes: The whole window coloured by clusters with the outlier slider at its default 100 percent: scattered cells sit between and around the clusters, and the sidebar reads Showing all 3,696 points.

filtering-active-filters-row-disabled.name: active-filters-row-disabled
filtering-active-filters-row-disabled.describes: The same three-row filter list with the clusters hiding row unchecked, so its text ends in the bracketed word disabled, its row is dimmed, and the count line above has risen.

filtering-active-filters-remove.name: active-filters-remove-button
filtering-active-filters-remove.describes: A one-row filter list with the pointer resting on the remove cross at the right edge of the row.

filtering-window-gene-range-scope-lost.name: window-gene-range-scope-lost
filtering-window-gene-range-scope-lost.describes: The same window after switching the active field to clusters: every cell is drawn again, the Ins1 row has left the filter list, and the count line reads Showing all 3,696 points.

fields-selector-rows.name: field-selectors-three-routes
fields-selector-rows.describes: The three field selectors stacked in order — Categorical obs holding clusters, Continuous obs holding None, and an empty Gene Expression search box — each followed by four small icon buttons.

fields-legend-categorical.name: legend-categorical-clusters
fields-legend-categorical.describes: The categorical legend for clusters: the hint Click a swatch to pick a color, the Show All and Hide All buttons, and eight rows each holding a checkbox, a colour swatch, a label, a cell count, a rename pencil and a delete bin.

fields-legend-continuous.name: legend-continuous-sscore
fields-legend-continuous.describes: The continuous legend for S_score: a Viridis colour bar with its two numeric end points, a Log color scale toggle reading Off, a Rescale colorbar to slider range toggle reading On, and the whole Filtering block beneath them.

fields-colormap-menu.name: legend-colormap-menu-open
fields-colormap-menu.describes: The colormap picker expanded under the S_score colour bar, a grid of named gradient swatches with Viridis marked as the active one.

fields-gene-search-open.name: gene-search-dropdown-open
fields-gene-search-open.describes: The Gene Expression search box holding the letters Rp with its dropdown open below, listing the gene names that contain them.

fields-window-gene-coloring.name: window-color-by-gene-ins1
fields-window-gene-coloring.describes: The whole window coloured by expression of the gene Ins1 on a Viridis scale, dark where the gene is absent and bright in one lobe of the embedding, with the continuous legend open in the sidebar.

fields-window-centroids.name: window-centroids-and-labels
fields-window-centroids.describes: The Pancreas embedding coloured by clusters with Show centroids and Show labels both ticked, so each cluster carries a marker at its centre and its category name printed beside it.

core-navigation-orbit.name: navigation-controls-orbit
core-navigation-orbit.describes: The Navigation block with Mode set to Orbit, exposing a keyboard speed slider, a Google Earth-style drag checkbox and a Show orbit anchor checkbox.

core-navigation-planar.name: navigation-controls-planar
core-navigation-planar.describes: The Navigation block with Mode set to Planar, exposing a pan speed slider, a Zoom to cursor checkbox and an Invert axes checkbox.

core-navigation-freefly.name: navigation-controls-freefly
core-navigation-freefly.describes: The Navigation block with Mode set to Free-fly, exposing look sensitivity and move speed sliders with numeric readouts, invert look and projectile checkboxes, and a Capture pointer button.

core-window-dimension-3d.name: window-dimension-3d
core-window-dimension-3d.describes: The whole window showing the Pancreas 3D embedding inside its grid box, with the Dimension select reading 3D and the Navigation Mode select reading Orbit.

core-window-dimension-2d.name: window-dimension-2d
core-window-dimension-2d.describes: The same window after choosing 2D: the cells now lie on a plane seen face-on, the Dimension select reads 2D, and the Navigation Mode select has followed it to Planar.

core-window-dimension-1d.name: window-dimension-1d
core-window-dimension-1d.describes: The same window after choosing 1D: the cells are spread along one axis, the Dimension select reads 1D, and the Navigation Mode select has followed it to Planar.

core-render-mode-select.name: render-mode-select
core-render-mode-select.describes: A control labelled RENDER MODE holding a dropdown that reads Points, ringed and with the pointer pressing it, above a dashed box labelled DEPTH PERCEPTION whose first slider, POINT SIZE (LOG), reads 0.75.

orientation-window-map.name: window-orientation-map
orientation-window-map.describes: The whole application window with the Pancreas sample loaded, the sidebar scrolled to Coloring and Filtering, the embedding coloured by clusters, and the eight-row legend beside the matching colours on the canvas.

fields-gene-search-no-match.name: gene-search-no-match
fields-gene-search-no-match.describes: The Gene Expression dropdown after typing a symbol this sample does not publish: a no-match line, a sentence giving the number of gene names the dataset publishes, and a link about why a gene may be missing.

sessions-refusal-not-a-session-file.name: refusal-02-not-a-session-file
sessions-refusal-not-a-session-file.describes: Two notifications reading "Invalid session file (bad MAGIC header)." after a file that is not a session bundle was chosen in Load State.

sessions-refusal-different-dataset.name: refusal-01-different-dataset
sessions-refusal-different-dataset.describes: Notifications reporting that the session was saved on a different dataset than the one open now, naming the cell and gene counts the file was saved against and the counts of the dataset currently open.

sessions-save-restore-01-session-control.name: save-restore-01-session-controls
sessions-save-restore-01-session-control.describes: The Session accordion showing the loaded dataset summary, the sample picker, the local, remote-server and GitHub loading controls, and the Session state block with Save State and Load State at the bottom.

sessions-save-restore-02-save-state-acti.name: save-restore-02-save-state-action
sessions-save-restore-02-save-state-acti.describes: The Session state block with Save State and Load State side by side and the pointer on Save State.

sessions-renderer-controls-default.name: save-restore-05-renderer-controls-default
sessions-renderer-controls-default.describes: The renderer settings block at its defaults, with Shader quality set to Full, Level-of-Detail unchecked and Frustum culling unchecked.

sessions-renderer-controls-changed.name: save-restore-06-renderer-controls-changed
sessions-renderer-controls-changed.describes: The renderer settings block with Shader quality set to Light, Level-of-Detail checked, Force LOD level set to 4 and Frustum culling checked.

sessions-renderer-controls-restored.name: save-restore-08-renderer-controls-restored
sessions-renderer-controls-restored.describes: The renderer settings block after restoring a saved session, showing Shader quality Light, Level-of-Detail checked, Force LOD level 4 and Frustum culling checked, matching the values that were saved.

sessions-official-sample-state-applied.name: official-01-sample-state-applied
sessions-official-sample-state-applied.describes: The whole application window shortly after the Pancreas built-in sample was chosen, showing the embedding coloured by cell type in a 3-D orbit view on a light grid background, with the Session accordion open beside it.

sessions-save-confirmation.name: save-restore-03-save-confirmation
sessions-save-confirmation.describes: A notification reading "Session saved successfully" after Save State produced a session bundle.

sessions-restore-confirmation.name: save-restore-04-restore-confirmation
sessions-restore-confirmation.describes: Notifications after a completed restore, ending with "Session fully restored." and "Session loaded successfully".

sessions-restored-view.name: save-restore-07-restored-view
sessions-restored-view.describes: The whole application window immediately after a session restore, with the dataset drawn in the viewer and the sidebar showing the restored control values.

accessibility-panel-keyboard-shortcuts.name: keyboard-shortcuts
accessibility-panel-keyboard-shortcuts.describes: The Keyboard Shortcuts panel open in the Cellucid sidebar, listing five groups of shortcuts: the ungrouped global keys R, F, H, 1/2/3, O/P/G and ?; Navigation (Orbit / Planar / Free-fly) with W A S D and Shift; Orbit and Planar only with the zoom keys; Free-fly specific with E/Q and Esc; and Highlighting with Alt+click, Alt+drag, Shift+Alt+click, Ctrl+Alt+click, Esc and X.

analysis-detailed-categorical-preview.name: detailed-categorical
analysis-detailed-categorical-preview.describes: The Detailed panel with Variable set to Categorical obs then cell_type, a Compare pages block with Page 1 and Rest of Page 1 both selected, a Plot Type select reading Bar Plot under a pointer, and a grouped bar plot of cell-type counts beneath it whose horizontal axis carries a single category name.

analysis-de-sidebar-result.name: de-sidebar-result
analysis-de-sidebar-result.describes: A small volcano plot in the sidebar with a red cloud on the right, a blue cloud on the left and a grey cloud in the middle, its axes labelled and no legend, and an Expand button below it with a pointer on it.

analysis-de-volcano-expanded.name: de-volcano-expanded
analysis-de-volcano-expanded.describes: A large modal headed DIFFERENTIAL EXPRESSION: PAGE 1 VS REST OF PAGE 1, divided into four regions: a volcano plot with labelled genes top-left over a legend reading Up (396), Down (701) and Not significant (2656) drawn below its axis title, an Export row of PNG, SVG and CSV buttons and a PLOT OPTIONS column on the right, a SUMMARY STATISTICS table bottom-left, and a STATISTICAL ANALYSIS panel bottom-right holding the Top Differentially Expressed Genes table.

analysis-marker-genes-ranked.name: marker-genes-ranked
analysis-marker-genes-ranked.describes: The Marker Genes panel with Mode set to Ranked Genes and the help line "Show top markers sorted by significance", a Wilcoxon method select, a Discover Markers button, and beneath it a heatmap of eight cell-type rows against many gene columns with a Z-score colour bar, its gene axis carrying evenly spaced, separated names.

analysis-marker-genes-clustered.name: marker-genes-clustered
analysis-marker-genes-clustered.describes: A heatmap with cell-type groups down one axis and gene names across the other, dendrograms attached to both axes, and a colour bar for the Z-scored expression.

loading-refusal-h5ad-wrong-file.name: fail-h5ad-wrong-file
loading-refusal-h5ad-wrong-file.describes: A Cellucid notification reading "The selected file is not a valid HDF5/H5AD file. Choose an AnnData .h5ad file or regenerate it with AnnData.", with a dismiss button at its right.

loading-refusal-missing-umap-embedding.name: fail-missing-umap-embedding
loading-refusal-missing-umap-embedding.describes: A Cellucid notification reading "No exact UMAP embedding found in obsm. Expected one or more of X_umap_1d, X_umap_2d, or X_umap_3d. Available obsm keys: X_pca.", with a dismiss button at its right.

analysis-detailed-expanded.name: detailed-expanded
analysis-detailed-expanded.describes: The expanded Detailed modal headed COMPARING: CELL_TYPE with a grouped bar plot top-left whose horizontal axis prints five of the eight category names, an Export row and PLOT OPTIONS column on the right, a SUMMARY STATISTICS table bottom-left, and a STATISTICAL ANALYSIS panel bottom-right holding a chi-squared card reading N/A, with a pointer on the CSV button.

analysis-autorun-detailed-preview.name: autorun-vs-run-a
analysis-autorun-detailed-preview.describes: The Detailed panel holding a finished result — Variable set to Categorical obs then cell_type, two pages selected, Bar Plot chosen and a grouped bar plot drawn beneath — with no Run button anywhere in the panel.

analysis-marker-genes-expanded.name: marker-genes-expanded
analysis-marker-genes-expanded.describes: The expanded Marker Genes modal headed MARKER GENES: CELL_TYPE with a clustered heatmap and dendrograms in the plot area, an Export row of PNG, SVG and CSV buttons above a PLOT OPTIONS column, a SUMMARY STATISTICS panel naming the category, mode, method and counts, and a STATISTICAL ANALYSIS panel holding the Top Marker Genes table, with a pointer on the CSV button.

analysis-volcano-threshold-permissive.name: volcano-threshold-a
analysis-volcano-threshold-permissive.describes: A volcano plot at a log2 fold-change threshold of 0.5, with broad red and blue clouds of coloured points either side of a narrow grey band, and a legend below the axis title counting each colour.

analysis-volcano-threshold-strict.name: volcano-threshold-b
analysis-volcano-threshold-strict.describes: The same volcano plot at a log2 fold-change threshold of 3, with the threshold lines pushed far apart and almost every point now grey, and a legend below the axis title counting each colour.
